name: Depth Reinitialization
definition: A method to alleviate 'overlapping' and 'under-reconstruction' by leveraging dense depth information to reorganize the spatial distribution of Gaussians.
summary: Depth Reinitialization is a regularization strategy that alleviates artifacts in 3D Gaussian Splatting by reorganizing Gaussians using geometric mid-point depths instead of standard alpha-blended maps.
